answer: Agents can earn transaction capacity only by locking tokens for a fixed period, with each account capped by the value of its lock rather than by its claimed identity. A mirror of one honest agent’s profile therefore grants no extra influence: splitting the same stake across a thousand accounts leaves total capacity unchanged. To overwhelm voting or markets, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, paying opportunity cost and risking slashing if a raven-like challenge proves coordinated fraud; even shale-rich capital cannot make identities free.
